D.treatment: A-level Physics students taking the AQA Engineering Physics option

O.outcome_detail: prior exposure to advanced rotational motion and moment of inertia

cells.quote: Only 15% of AQA entries (8% overall) are Engineering Physics. This is significant, largely accounts for overall 91% of UG students who have not previously seen advanced rotational motion concepts such as moment of inertia (this topic is not covered in the core of any other specification, nor is it encountered in Maths or Further Maths A-level current specifications
cells.note: The curriculum mapping compares prior A-level exposure across exam-board options; the text reports the percentage not previously encountering the topic rather than an experimental learning effect.
